decisions.rationale: The shared Web-and-React check must sample html-css-js objectives. Sequencing: the html-css-js intake lands first, then this intake (rebased) adds a representative set of the merged html-css-js objective ids, mapped to the existing MCQ/coding formats within the 45-minute item plan. Until then, record the gap in intake.md and the blueprint notes; do not invent ids.

Scope the 45-minute one-sitting instruction to S35/Standard. Record FT20 delivery timing as an open pacing item for the Fast overlay and the platform assessment owner. No Fast schedule is stated and no policy is invented.

Keep the frozen FT18 order. Remove accessible-forms as a hard prerequisite of the submission-errors topic and teach the minimum notification behaviour just in time; the later Accessible forms page consolidates it.
Relabel the FT19 row 'Project implementation (source snapshot dayType: Lab)'. Keep the statement that Fast gets no coding-lab artifact; S34 remains the Standard coding-lab carrier.
Replace the wording with: fetch does not reject merely because the server returned a non-2xx status, so check response.ok. Treat aborts and malformed requests separately.
State the general HTTP meanings of 401 and 403 first, then the project API contract (401: clear auth state and sign in; 403: keep the session and show not-authorized).
Make o1 non-exhaustive ('state updates and parent renders as two causes taught so far'), and connect a changed context value as a further trigger in the later context topic.
